sentences.text: David Velez Osorno is the founder, chairman and chief executive officer of Nu Holdings Ltd., the holding company of Brazilian digital bank Nubank; the company's 2025 Form 20-F lists him, at age 44, as Founder, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.
A Colombian banker, engineer and entrepreneur, he was born in Medellin in 1981 and holds a Bachelor of Science in management science and engineering and an MBA, both from Stanford University.

sentences.quote: He also spent time as a partner at Sequoia Capital from 2011 to 2013, where he led the firm's Latin American investments
sentences.text: Before founding Nu in 2013 he was a partner at Sequoia Capital from January 2011 to March 2013, heading its Latin American investments group, following roles in investment banking and growth equity at Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley and General Atlantic.
He launched Nubank with co-founders Cristina Junqueira and Edward Wible, and the company listed on the New York Stock Exchange in December 2021.

sentences.text: On June 1, 2026 Nu named Rob Livingston, formerly Visa's CFO for North America, as chief financial officer effective July 13, succeeding Guilherme Lago, who moved to Special Advisor to the management team and the Audit and Risk Committee after five years as CFO, supporting the transition through August 31.
Nu said the planned transition does not change its operating model, risk appetite or long-term strategy, and it is creating a dedicated Brazil CFO role alongside those in Mexico and Colombia.

sentences.quote: CEO David Velez said Livingston brings deep knowledge of global financial institutions and a clear view of the US, where Nubank has already received conditional approval for a bank and where Livingston will be based.
sentences.text: Velez tied the hire to the US, where Nu holds conditional bank approval and Livingston will be based, with focus still on core-market growth, AI and disciplined expansion.
